projects.name: Vela desktop app
notes: Frontend is SvelteKit/TypeScript configured as a static SPA.
Backend is Rust and owns media sources, config persistence, source mounting, and mpv playback.

projects.name: Linux packaging
projects.type: Tauri bundle files and Arch package files
notes: Tauri Linux bundle scripts install desktop database and icon cache refresh hooks.
Arch packaging expects a built release binary under src-tauri/target/release/vela.

verification.status: local-only. No `.gitea/workflows/` directory exists (Gitea's own documented trigger path), only `.github/workflows/`. Treat .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml as dead/inactive CI files until this repo is actually hosted or mirrored on GitHub, or the workflows are moved to .gitea/workflows/ and a run is observed. Run these commands locally before claiming completion; do not rely on CI to catch failures.

commands.when: Production frontend build or any change that can affect the Tauri frontend bundle.

packaging_commands.when: Linux .deb/.rpm bundle changes, when the local system has Tauri Linux prerequisites.
Arch packaging changes, when makepkg and package prerequisites are available.

policy.code_changes: Run current automated verification before claiming completion.
policy.docs_only: Code verification is not required unless docs affect setup, commands, runtime behavior, generated files, or user-visible behavior.
policy.manual_behavior: Run the relevant manual check, smoke test, or playtest for behavior not covered by automation, or state clearly that it was not run.
